why_visit_zh: 让图谱在博物馆附近有美食连接点。

description_en: Neighbourhood market food cluster north of the city.
description_zh: 市区北部社区巴刹美食群。
why_visit_en: Good local breakfast node outside standard tourist tracks.
why_visit_zh: 标准游客路线外的本地早餐节点。

description_en: Neighbourhood food court in Bercham.
description_zh: 巴占一带社区美食中心。
why_visit_en: Useful for routes staying outside Old Town.
why_visit_zh: 适合不在旧街场活动的路线。

description_en: Pomelo stall area associated with Tambun.
description_zh: 与打扪相关的柚子档区域。
why_visit_en: Good fruit souvenir node after Tambun or cave routes.
why_visit_zh: 打扪或洞庙路线后适合买水果手信。

description_en: Souvenir snack reference around Menglembu.
description_zh: 万里望一带的手信小吃参考。
why_visit_en: Useful if route heads west from Ipoh centre.
why_visit_zh: 路线往怡保西侧时可顺路。

description_en: Neighbourhood food court west of Old Town.
description_zh: 旧街场西侧社区美食中心。
why_visit_en: Adds local dinner option for western Ipoh routes.
why_visit_zh: 为怡保西侧路线加入本地晚餐点。

description_en: Food cluster around Pasir Pinji.
description_zh: 兵如港一带美食群。
why_visit_en: Helps connect yong tau foo and cave temple directions.
why_visit_zh: 连接酿料小吃和洞庙方向很有用。

description_en: Dessert cluster reference for Old Town route planning.
description_zh: 旧街场路线规划用甜品群参考。
why_visit_en: Gives travellers a softer stop after heritage walks.
why_visit_zh: 古迹步行后让路线有轻松甜品点。

description_en: Food court reference around Greentown.
description_zh: 绿城一带美食中心参考。
why_visit_en: Practical dinner node near city hotels and malls.
why_visit_zh: 靠近市区酒店和商场，晚餐实用。

description_en: Food strip reference around Ipoh Garden.
description_zh: 怡保花园一带美食带参考。
why_visit_en: Good connector between Kinta City, Bercham and Tambun.
why_visit_zh: 连接近打城、巴占和打扪方向。

description_en: Cultural street area with shops and food references.
description_zh: 有商店和食物气氛的文化街区。
why_visit_en: Adds cultural contrast near white coffee and market routes.
why_visit_zh: 在白咖啡和市场路线附近加入文化层次。

description_en: Historic mosque landmark near New Town and Mural Art's Lane.
description_zh: 靠近新街场和壁画巷的历史清真寺地标。
why_visit_en: Good architectural stop between mural and food nodes.
why_visit_zh: 适合连接壁画和美食节点。

description_en: Historic school building and city landmark.
description_zh: 历史学校建筑和城市地标。
why_visit_en: Adds architectural context near New Town and river routes.
why_visit_zh: 为新街场和河畔路线加入建筑脉络。

description_en: Historic school landmark in Ipoh.
description_zh: 怡保历史学校地标。
why_visit_en: Useful context node for civic heritage beyond Old Town.
why_visit_zh: 让古迹路线不只局限旧街场。

description_en: Museum explaining geology and mineral context around Ipoh.
description_zh: 介绍怡保地质与矿物背景的博物馆。
why_visit_en: Excellent learning stop before cave temples and limestone lakes.
why_visit_zh: 去洞庙和石灰岩湖前很适合补充知识。

description_en: Museum covering Perak history and local heritage.
description_zh: 介绍霹雳历史与本地文化的博物馆。
why_visit_en: Good cultural node near riverfront and Old Town edges.
why_visit_zh: 靠近河畔和旧街场边缘的文化节点。

description_en: Heritage gallery-style stop in Old Town.
description_zh: 旧街场历史展馆式停靠点。
why_visit_en: Adds a quieter cultural stop near busy lanes.
why_visit_zh: 在热闹小巷旁加入较安静的文化点。

description_zh: 旧街场知名壁画拍照点。
why_visit_en: Tiny node that links coffee culture with street art.
why_visit_zh: 小节点，却能连接白咖啡文化和街头艺术。

description_zh: 旧街场街头艺术拍照点。
why_visit_en: Good micro-stop when walking between lanes.
why_visit_zh: 在小巷之间步行时可作为微停靠点。

description_zh: DR 公园附近较安静的花园区。

why_visit_zh: 靠近河畔路线的短绿色连接点。

why_visit_en: Good family and walking node near Ipoh Garden.
why_visit_zh: 靠近怡保花园，适合家庭和散步。

why_visit_en: Useful long-distance node when travellers have a car.
why_visit_zh: 旅客有车时可作为较远路线节点。
source_note: Outside Ipoh city; verify travel time.

description_zh: 与霹雳锡矿历史有关的铁船遗址。
why_visit_en: Good extended route for visitors interested in mining heritage.
why_visit_zh: 适合对锡矿历史有兴趣的延伸路线。

description_en: Heritage house in Gopeng for extended Ipoh-area routes.
description_zh: 务边的文物馆，适合怡保周边延伸路线。
why_visit_en: Good pairing with Gopeng nature and day trips.
why_visit_zh: 可和务边自然路线组合。

description_en: Adventure area around Gopeng for rafting operators.
description_zh: 务边一带激流活动区域。
why_visit_en: Separate active day-trip route rather than casual city stop.
why_visit_zh: 较适合独立户外半日路线。

description_en: Limestone cave area reference near Tambun.
description_zh: 打扪附近石灰岩洞穴区域参考。
why_visit_en: Useful as a geological context node near hot springs.
why_visit_zh: 靠近温泉，适合作为地质脉络节点。

description_en: Ipoh airport and transport arrival node.
description_zh: 怡保机场交通抵达节点。
why_visit_en: Important for travellers planning route order from arrival.
why_visit_zh: 旅客从机场抵达时可决定路线顺序。

description_en: Main express bus terminal north of Ipoh.
description_zh: 怡保北部主要长途巴士总站。
why_visit_en: Important arrival/departure node for overland travellers.
why_visit_zh: 陆路旅客抵达和离开时的重要节点。

description_en: Local bus station near Ipoh Railway Station.
description_zh: 靠近怡保火车站的本地巴士站。
why_visit_en: Important public-transport connector for Old Town routes.
why_visit_zh: 旧街场公共交通路线的重要连接点。

why_visit_en: Useful practical node for hotel-based travellers.
why_visit_zh: 适合以酒店为中心规划的旅客。

why_visit_en: Useful when travellers arrive by express bus.
why_visit_zh: 旅客搭长途巴士抵达时很有用。

description_en: Hypermarket stop near Amanjaya terminal.
description_zh: 靠近 Amanjaya 总站的大型超市。
why_visit_en: Practical supply stop for bus-arrival travellers.
why_visit_zh: 长途巴士抵达旅客补给很实用。

description_zh: 美鲁交通区的辨识地标。
why_visit_en: Helps explain northern transport route geometry.
why_visit_zh: 有助理解怡保北部交通路线。
